rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for saying someone is not selfish.

example.english: They are unselfish and always share good things with others.
example.traditional: 佢做人唔自私，有好嘢一定同人分享。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zou6 jan4 m4 zi6 si1 jau5 hou2 je5 jat1 ding6 tung4 jan4 fan1 hoeng2

rows.note: Use this when unselfishness is shown by being generous with money, possessions, or help.

example.english: You are really unselfish and are always treating me to meals.
example.traditional: 你真係好大方，成日請我食飯。
example.jyutping: nei5 zan1 hai6 hou2 daai6 fong1 seng4 jat6 ceng2 ngo5 sik6 faan6

rows.note: Use this for a more elevated description of selfless dedication or concern for others.

example.english: They have shown an unselfish commitment to caring for disadvantaged children for years.
example.traditional: 佢多年嚟無私咁照顧一班基層兒童。
example.jyutping: keoi5 do1 nin4 lai4 mou4 si1 gam3 ziu3 gu3 jat1 baan1 gei1 cang4 ji4 tung4
